text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Mom and Dad! Summer training camp to 
build up our skills starts today. It's 
crazy hot, but I've gotta do my best!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"If I run super cool-like, everything 
should turn around for the better! I'm 
gonna get stronger for the Queen Stakes!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"P.S. Thank you so much for the letter of 
encouragement! I'm doing super duper 
great! The cold noodles you sent gave me a 
hundred times more energy! Nothing can 
scare me now!"
